subject: Warning in run(timeoutMS) - How to view warning message

messages.author: 07beff09857fc2d4
messages.subject: Warning in run(timeoutMS) - How to view warning message
parts:
This may seem like a very basic question.

How can I see what line of code in my app are throwing a warning?

I see this printed to the consol:
"Warning in run(timeoutMs)"

sometime I get a bit more info but not usually.

How can I actually view the warning that was thrown?

Thanks,

Sam

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Warning in run(timeoutMS) - How to view warning message
parts:
This is about to get a lot better, but isn't merged onto master yet. I would appreciate it if you could give this a try and let me know how it goes.

1) Install this new branch of Shiny: devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny@joe/feature/better-errors")
2) Before launching your Shiny app, call: options(warn=2)

options(warn=2) will turn warnings into errors. Installing that branch should show more precise error stack info.
